rfon_pm is floored on each log line: the RF core term may read up to 1 per-mille of on-time low

RF core idle (LB) is a LOWER BOUND: it charges the core's on-time outside TX/RX at the idle delta, but the synth locked after CMD_FS draws mA and the boot before setup is not in rfon at all (RF synth/boot, UNKNOWN, excluded); the driver's wake budget, power-ups/s x pudur_us, is 1781 us/s (1.78 per-mille), informational
